Task: Create monorepo and code ownership boundaries
Acceptance: Repository boundaries, ownership and platform target definitions are checked in; executable platform shells are qualified at M2.

Task: Freeze product contracts and schema versioning
Acceptance: Versioned schemas, transition and approval semantics, feature registry, commit protocol and negative contract fixtures are reviewed; package validation passes. No runtime execution evidence is implied.

Task: Create feature flag and capability registry
Acceptance: Features can be disabled by platform/device without divergent UI code.
Upgrade/downgrade fixtures preserve user settings or fail safely.

Task: Create reproducible dev environment and bootstrap
Acceptance: One command validates Rust/Dart/native toolchains and runs smoke tests.
Home/Work/Agents/Models/Skills/Knowledge/Activity/Settings render at compact/medium/expanded breakpoints.

Task: Implement Harbor design tokens and themes
Acceptance: Light/dark/RTL token snapshots pass; no hard-coded colors in product widgets.

Task: Implement desktop Harbor Rail and Harbor Lens
Acceptance: Rail collapse, lens pin/close, keyboard focus and state restoration pass.

Task: Implement mobile navigation and Capture route
Acceptance: Bottom navigation preserves stacks; capture handles file/photo/text share-in.

Task: Implement command palette and keyboard map
Acceptance: All primary actions reachable by keyboard; conflicts tested on both OSes.

Task: Implement accessibility semantics and focus order
Acceptance: Screen reader labels, keyboard traversal, dynamic text and reduced motion pass.

Task: Create Rust harbor_core crate and Dart FFI facade
Acceptance: Async streaming, cancellation, structured errors and memory ownership soak test pass.

Task: Implement typed event bus and durable run event schema
Acceptance: Versioned typed events replay deterministically. Unknown authority/state events halt replay. Only authenticated envelope-marked ignorable_display extensions can be skipped. Lease and monotonic-budget checks are transactional.

Task: Implement capability broker and permission receipts
Acceptance: Every protected effect carries capability scope and receipt; negative bypass tests pass.
Background, suspend, quit and task cancellation leave no locked model/file handles.
UI receives stable error codes with actionable recovery metadata.

Task: Vendor/pin llama.cpp and build universal C ABI
Acceptance: Pinned revision builds on arm64 iOS/macOS/Android and x64/arm64 Windows.

Task: Implement GGUF model loader and streaming generation
Acceptance: Cancel <250ms target; context/sampler/tool grammar fixtures pass.
Metal/CUDA/Vulkan/HIP/SYCL/CPU availability reported accurately without crash.
Availability, session, tool calls and fallback conform to shared ModelProvider contract.
Gemini Nano/ML Kit availability and offline calls conform to shared provider contract.
Catalog/load/stream/unload conform to ModelProvider; absence falls back cleanly.
Disabled by default; domain/key policy and per-request Local/Hybrid/Remote indicator enforced.

Task: Implement model router and task profiles
Acceptance: Router respects user lock, privacy mode, capability need, context, memory and thermal state.
Stable prefixes reused without mixing workspaces/users/models.

Task: Define Harbor Model Manifest and signed catalog schema
Acceptance: Manifest supports source revision, files, checksums, license, architecture, capabilities and device hints.

Task: Implement device profiler and Fit Score
Acceptance: Fit Score uses measured RAM/storage/backends and never recommends known non-loadable model.

Task: Implement Harbor catalog client and signature verification
Acceptance: Tampered/expired catalog rejected; cached last-known-good remains usable.
Public repo URL/search resolves metadata without executing repository code.
Read/fine-grained token is stored only in OS secure store and redacted from logs.
User is sent to browser to request access; app retries download after authenticated access.
HTTP Range/ETag, pause/resume, retry/backoff, storage check and progress survive restart.
Downloaded weight bound to exact source revision; checksum mismatch quarantined.

Task: Implement model install/uninstall and immutable store
Acceptance: No partial install visible; in-use deletion blocked; uninstall frees all owned files.

Accept only allowlisted data files in harbor.model/v3 packages or a single GGUF wrapped into such a package. Reject executable content, malformed metadata, escaping/colliding paths and incomplete packages.

Task: Implement benchmark lab and measured profile cache
Acceptance: TTFT/tok-s/RAM/thermal measured; tests do not leak prompt content.
Complete transition table including paused/cancelling states is deterministic; terminal completion from Running is explicit.
Max steps/time/tool-output/context budgets enforced with user-visible stop reason.
Tools expose JSON schema, risk class, capabilities, deterministic result envelope.
Protected effects cannot dispatch before approval bound to canonical arguments, target, policy version and effect intent; allow-once receipt is single-use and expiring.
Run resumes from durable event state with persisted pause reason/budgets and executor lease; completed effects are observed, never repeated.
Each model/tool/approval/artifact event has concise user-readable entry and expandable details.

Task: Implement agent profiles and model/tool policy
Acceptance: Profile can pin model class, knowledge, tools, approval strategy and max budget.
Builder validates unsafe combinations and produces versioned profile manifest.
YAML/Markdown skill schema supports instructions, tools, knowledge hints, input/output contract and version.
Bundled skills verified and versioned; failed signature disables skill.
No executable code in v1 skill; tool allowlist and syntax validated before enable.
All file access is scoped to user-selected handles; output and size limits tested.
Schema-constrained results pass malformed-output recovery cases.
WASI or process sandbox is deny-by-default and unavailable on mobile by default.
Threads/runs/settings/artifact refs survive crash; DB key stored in OS keystore.
Cross-platform persisted permissions degrade safely when OS revokes access.
Embedding model can be installed independently and resource budgeted.
PDF/DOCX/TXT/MD sources index incrementally with source checksum and deletion propagation.
Top-k search returns source spans and deterministic citation handles.
User can inspect/remove/reindex sources and see disk cost/index health.
Context respects model window, source priority, recent thread and tool state with traceable truncation.

Task: Define Artifact IR and typed edit operations
Acceptance: IR covers text blocks/tables/sheets/cells/slides/media/metadata with stable identifiers.
Zip bomb, path traversal, external relationship and oversized XML tests pass.
Paragraph/table/style/header/footer edits preserve untouched package parts; round-trip golden tests pass.
XLSX import/preserve/patch plus qualified formula recalculation work for the supported matrix; unsupported formulas are preserved and marked unverified, never silently guessed.
Slides/text/images/notes/themes preserved where untouched; generated deck opens cleanly.
Text and page image extraction works across platforms; OCR provider is platform-adapted.
Diff summarizes paragraphs, cells/formulas and slides against a specific base artifact version/hash before approval.
Original/output checksums, encrypted artifact bytes, operation log, model/run provenance, restore and garbage-collection metadata are durable.
Built-in Office agents use typed operation batches, diff/version store and base-version-bound protected write flow only.
Reference XLSX→verified analysis→PPTX workflow completes locally with trace, base-version-bound approval, safe commit and resumability.

Task: Implement central Egress Broker and Network Log
Acceptance: All outbound traffic is classified, attributed, logged and policy-checked.

Task: Implement optional web fetch/search tool interface
Acceptance: Disabled in Local mode; size/content-type/domain limits and prompt-injection marking enforced.
Tokens live in secure store; refresh and revoke are audited; least scopes requested.
Read actions distinct from send/write; protected effects require approval.

Task: Implement E2EE sync log and key model
Acceptance: Optional sync implements the approved protocol: ciphertext-only server, device enrollment/key epochs, replay detection, conflicts, recovery and revocation.
User sees last sync, registered devices, storage, revoke and reset actions.

Task: Exclude model weights from sync by default
Acceptance: When sync is enabled, sync manifests exclude weights and device-local execution authority by protocol.
Keychain, security-scoped bookmarks, share extension, lifecycle, AFM and Metal hooks pass.
Keystore, SAF, share intents, AICore/ML Kit availability, lifecycle and thermal hooks pass.
Credential Manager/DPAPI, file picker handles, Foundry/WinML discovery, GPU info and packaging pass.
Downloads/index jobs comply with OS background restrictions and resume safely.

Task: Implement deep links/share targets/app intents where supported
Acceptance: External open/share requests always require visible user context and scoped import.

Task: Threat model and security invariants in repository
Acceptance: Threats map to tests and owners; release blocks on unresolved critical invariants.

Task: Implement secret redaction and log policy
Acceptance: Tokens, prompts, document content and paths excluded from telemetry by default.

Task: Implement secure wipe and retention controls
Acceptance: User can delete data with defined crypto-erasure/GC semantics; backup retention and shared/public data behavior are disclosed and tested.
Corpus and property tests cover parsers and no crash escapes fuzz sandbox.
HTTPS default; explicit warning for insecure LAN endpoint; optional pinning supported.
Local mode completes core workflows with network physically unavailable and no hidden dependency.
Coverage gates focus on policy, parsers, state machines and cross-platform contracts.

Task: Create golden UI test matrix incl. RTL
Acceptance: Compact/medium/desktop + light/dark + EN/AR snapshots reviewed.
Qualified device/model/runtime/backend matrix records load success, TTFT, throughput, memory and thermal behavior against populated release thresholds.
Realistic DOCX/XLSX/PPTX fixtures preserve unsupported content through no-op round trip.
Pinned EN/AR datasets score answer grounding, tool correctness, effect necessity, approval correctness, resume/idempotency and abstention against release thresholds.
WCAG 2.2 AA-oriented checks + VoiceOver/TalkBack/Narrator manual scripts.
N-2 database/settings/catalog/skill manifests upgrade without data loss.

Task: Create CI matrix for Flutter/Rust/native targets
Acceptance: PR gates build/test lint on supported target architectures.
Pinned source + checksums produce signed SBOM and deterministic version metadata.
Produces IPA archive, macOS app, MSIX/installer and Android AAB/APK candidates.
Private signing keys never enter repo; release can be promoted from verified unsigned artifact.
Catalog changes are schema-validated, reviewed, signed, staged and rollbackable.
Diagnostics are content-free by default; user can preview payload before opt-in send.

Task: Create reproducible release qualification report generator
Acceptance: One command emits target applicability, missing evidence and validation status; it cannot turn absent product results into PASS.

Task: Implement executable release-scope ledger and gate evaluator
Acceptance: A release/platform/feature selection yields exactly one required-gate set with PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/N/A_DISABLED/N/A_PLATFORM states; every blocking gate requires evidence.

Task: Formalize durable run transitions, pause semantics and executor lease
Acceptance: Process-kill replay at every transition restores state/budgets; approval-after-cancel and two concurrent resume requests are deterministic and single-owner.
Crash injection before dispatch, after remote acceptance, before local commit and on retry never creates an automatic duplicate; irreconcilable outcomes remain OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.

Task: Implement egress policy matrix and broker enforcement boundary
Acceptance: Acquisition/auth/download/inference/connectors/sync/diagnostics each have explicit policy; redirects re-authorize and credentials strip cross-origin; independent capture matches Harbor log.
Every mutation batch carries base hash/version, operation IDs and preconditions; revalidation occurs immediately before atomic/safe commit; retries and stale writes cannot overwrite external changes.
Private artifact blobs, extracts, embeddings, previews, temp files and backups have defined encryption/key rotation/deletion behavior; public weights are separated.

Task: Prove Office calculation/layout engine and publish feature matrix
Acceptance: Pinned formula engine and Harbor renderer pass representative workbook/document/deck corpus; supported/preserve-only/reject features and size ceilings are published.

Task: Publish device support matrix and performance qualification contract
Acceptance: Exact OS/architecture support and reference-device selection procedure are published; calibration records use the pinned workload protocol. Final GA measurements are required by HBR-132 and ACC-054.

Task: Implement index identity and grounded-answer evaluation contract
Acceptance: Embedding/chunker/tokenizer/preprocess identity versions indexes; incompatible changes rebuild/isolate; EN/AR citation support and abstention gates pass.

Task: Formalize optional sync protocol, conflicts, device authority and key epochs
Acceptance: Enrollment, key epochs, replay detection, tombstones, conflict rules and run ownership are specified and tested; approval receipts/device-local capabilities never transfer.

Task: Complete provider capability and atomic model-package contract
Acceptance: System-managed/installed/remote refs, capabilities, cancellation, load cleanup, multi-file roles, atomic install, catalog key rotation and benchmark identity are explicit.

Task: Remediate semantic design tokens and component contrast roles
Acceptance: Text/fill/border/on-fill tokens pass unrounded WCAG 2.2 AA contrast for all normal-text component states in light/dark themes.

Task: Publish language-by-feature matrix and offline Arabic OCR fallback
Acceptance: UI/model/OCR/embeddings/speech/artifact language support is explicit; Arabic and mixed Arabic/Latin scan fixtures work offline or limitation is blocked before capture.

Task: Map every UX route to owner, milestone, tasks and required states
Acceptance: Route IDs, feature/platform applicability, real implementation tasks, originating recovery states and evidence paths are validated without requiring the future UI implementation.

Task: Build reference feasibility prototype: local workbook to verified board deck
Acceptance: On a declared reference device, install a cached/local model fixture, open workbook, recalculate known answers, create deck, preview, approve, safe-save, kill and resume entirely offline. M2 repeats on every qualified target.

Task: Implement optional app lock and secure unlock lifecycle
Acceptance: Biometric/device credential unlock gates private workspace access; lock/background/restart clears active plaintext views and cannot be bypassed through deep links. Device revocation applies only when sync is enabled.
